purpose: Outcome-free selection of a distinct TP53-status-to-WEE1-dependency direction
endpoint_access: ScreenNaiveGeneScore.csv header identity only; no WEE1 score row or target value parsed
eligibility_rule: PassesQC == True, CanInclude == True, Library in {Avana, KY}, exact ScreenID-to-ModelID map, nonblank eligible OncotreeLineage
status_rule: matrix values restricted to {0,1,2}; primary exposure is TP53 damaging value >= 1 and reference is TP53 matrix value == 0
selection_basis: TP53-damaging-to-WEE1 is distinct from EXP017's TP53-matrix-intact-to-MDM2 direction, has the strongest eligible two-source metadata among the reviewed new candidates, and is biologically supported by primary genetic and pharmacologic evidence. KY planning power is below 0.80, so the experiment is permanently feasibility-only.

literature_search.selection_note: The cited studies support a TP53-associated WEE1 vulnerability in restricted KRAS-mutant NSCLC settings, including CRISPR/siRNA or inhibitor evidence. EXP020 tests only a matrix-defined TP53 proxy against source-specific WEE1 knockout dependency across frozen DepMap cohorts; it does not claim KRAS restriction, functional TP53 status, inhibitor response, treatment benefit, or clinical utility.
